nodes.title: Character 1 | Griddle
widgets_values: A completely invented cheerful barbecue dad in his late forties. Short, broad, powerful build with a round expressive face, warm brown skin, a bald head and a compact triangular auburn beard. Wears a brick-red sleeveless utility apron over a cream short-sleeve shirt, navy work trousers, oversized orange heatproof wrist cuffs and dark brown ankle boots. The apron ends above the knees, leaving both legs clearly visible. No hat, handheld utensils, lettering or loose accessories. His low boxing guard and bright grin give him a friendly powerhouse silhouette.

Griddle plants both boots, twists his torso and thrusts one open orange-cuffed palm toward the right, releasing a compact orange-and-gold flame ball. The free hand guards his chest. Keep the fire close to the forward palm so the game can launch a separate projectile; preserve the entire body and both feet inside the sprite cell.
The grill is hot. Your winning streak is toast.

Griddle plants both boots, thrusts both orange-cuffed palms forward toward the right and releases a low rolling wave of orange-and-gold flame that hugs the ground. Keep the flame compact near his palms in sprite art; the game supplies the traveling wave.
Well done. Just how I like my steaks, and my opponents.

With the trophy on the grill shelf, Griddle throws the biggest block party the cul-de-sac has ever seen. Even Baron Bylaw shows up for a plate, and leaves with a recipe card and a smile he swears was only smoke in his eyes.

nodes.title: Character 2 | Rivet
widgets_values: A completely invented workshop dad in his early fifties. Tall muscular build, deep umber skin, a long angular face, short silver tightly curled hair and an assertive half-smile. Indigo mechanic's jumpsuit with sleeves rolled to the elbows, a wide copper belt, compact copper forearm bracers and steel-gray work boots. Simple uncluttered silhouette with no tools hanging from the belt, no goggles, no hat and no writing. His grounded open-hand guard suggests precision and strength.

Rivet draws both bracers together at the waist and drives one palm toward the right, launching a tight cyan magnetic pulse with three small copper fragments orbiting its center. Keep the effect near the palm, the other arm guarding the body and every limb fully inside the sprite cell. No large floating tools or duplicated arms.
I fix everything. Your stance is next.

Rivet snaps both copper bracers together and drives one palm toward the right, firing a tight cyan magnetic spiral with copper fragments orbiting its core. Keep the spiral compact near the palm in sprite art.
Tightened every loose bolt. You were the last one.

Rivet spends the prize money fixing every flickering streetlight on the block, then opens a free Saturday fix-it workshop in his garage. The line of neighbors carrying broken toasters wraps around the corner.

nodes.title: Character 3 | Tempo
widgets_values: A completely invented music-teacher parent in their late thirties. Compact athletic build, light olive skin, a heart-shaped face, short coral-red swept pixie hair and expressive dark eyebrows. Cropped magenta track jacket over a plain cream shirt, tapered midnight-blue trousers, cream high-top sneakers and two simple violet padded wristbands. A small pair of rounded headphones rests snugly at the collar without a loose cable. Lively upright kickboxing guard; no handheld instrument, brand marks or green accents.

Tempo pivots on the back foot, brings both palms together and pushes them toward the right to launch one compact magenta-and-violet sound ring. A short pair of concentric rings stays near the hands. Keep the face, complete body and both shoes visible without duplicated silhouettes or musical-note lettering.
Keep up with the beat, or take a seat.
Tempo spins into a forward kick toward the right that releases a large magenta-and-violet sound shockwave of three concentric rings. Keep the rings close to the kicking foot in sprite art.
You were off-beat from the very first round.
Tempo turns the empty lot into an open-air stage. By the end of summer the whole neighborhood sings the encore together, even the neighbors who swore they could not carry a tune.

nodes.title: Character 4 | Nimbus
widgets_values: A completely invented community-garden mom in her mid forties. Medium-height sturdy build, golden-brown skin, a square kind face, a thick cream-colored braid tucked into a short loop at the back of the head, and a determined smile. Plum-purple short-sleeve work coveralls, a broad lavender waist sash with short tucked ends, pale blue fitted forearm cuffs and dark violet rain boots. No plants carried on the body, trailing fabric, watering can, hat, green clothing or lettering. A calm balanced martial-arts stance with open hands.

Nimbus lowers her center of gravity and extends the forward palm toward the right, forming a compact lavender cloud surrounded by pale blue water droplets. The opposite hand remains tucked near the ribs. Confine all droplets near the attacking palm; do not hide the face or crop either rain boot.
I raised a garden. I can handle a little thunder.
Nimbus raises both open palms toward the right and launches a dense lavender storm cloud crackling with pale blue lightning. Keep the cloud compact and attached to her palms in sprite art.
Storms pass. Gardens grow. You lost.
Where the association office once stood, Nimbus plants a community garden. The first sunflower blooms by autumn, and every kid on the street gets a little plot of their own.

nodes.title: Character 5 | Switchback
widgets_values: A completely invented bicycle-courier dad in his early forties. Tall lean build, cool dark-brown skin, a narrow expressive face, shaved head and a thin silver eyebrow notch. Wears a smooth amber bicycle helmet with open face and no visor, a bright yellow fitted windbreaker, maroon tapered riding trousers, navy fingerless gloves and navy-and-yellow trainers. No bicycle, bag, loose straps, glasses or brand marks. A light forward-leaning boxing guard and springy stance create a fast angular silhouette.

Switchback lunges with a sharp forward palm toward the right and releases a compact golden arrow-shaped energy pulse. Two short yellow motion streaks hug the attacking forearm. Keep one body only, with the rear foot planted and all helmet, gloves and shoes safely inside the sprite cell.
School run complete. Express knockout incoming.

Switchback bursts forward in a blur of short golden streaks and finishes with a sharp palm strike toward the right that releases a long golden arrow pulse. Keep the streaks hugging his body in sprite art.
Switchback trades the trophy for a fleet of secondhand bikes and starts a neighborhood courier club. Nothing on the block is ever late again, especially not dinner.

nodes.title: Character 6 | Brick
widgets_values: A completely invented neighborhood caretaker granddad in his early sixties. Very tall square heavyweight build, pale freckled skin, a broad rectangular face, flat silver crew cut and thick silver handlebar moustache. Wears a sleeveless rose-red quilted work vest over a charcoal fitted shirt, sand-colored work trousers, simple dark red knuckle wraps and chunky charcoal boots. No tools, cape, hat or lettering. A wide upright wrestling guard, massive shoulders and a warm stubborn grin make an unmistakable blocky silhouette.

Brick braces his wide stance and drives both wrapped hands forward toward the right, launching one compact rose-red block of energy edged in pale gold. The effect resembles a solid pressure wave rather than actual building debris. Preserve one complete fighter, both boots and the entire forward reach inside the sprite cell.
I built this block. Now hold your ground.
Brick slams both wrapped fists down and sends a massive rose-red pressure wave edged in pale gold rolling along the ground toward the right. Keep the wave compact near his fists in sprite art.
Built to last. You were not.
Brick rebuilds the old playground with his own two hands, plank by plank. When the first kid swings higher than the fence, he finally sits down on the new bench and lets himself grin.

nodes.title: Final boss | Baron Bylaw
widgets_values: A completely invented imposing neighborhood-association president in his late fifties and the final boss of the tournament. Very tall broad-shouldered build, light olive skin, a sharp angular face, slicked-back black hair with silver streaks and a neat thin moustache. Wears a charcoal double-breasted coat with gold piping ending at mid-thigh, a burgundy vest, a white high-collared shirt, charcoal trousers and polished black knee boots. One ornate golden gauntlet covers his right forearm and hand. No hat, cape, clipboard, cane, lettering or insignia. A commanding upright guard with the gauntlet raised gives him a regal, intimidating silhouette.

Baron Bylaw thrusts his golden gauntlet toward the right and releases a compact glowing golden orb edged in deep burgundy light. The free hand stays behind his back. Keep the energy close to the gauntlet and the complete body, coat and both boots inside the sprite cell.
This tournament is now in violation. Prepare for enforcement.
Baron Bylaw raises his golden gauntlet overhead and hurls a towering wall of golden light edged in burgundy toward the right. Keep the light attached to the gauntlet in sprite art.
The Baron reviews the tournament results, signs one final notice and quietly tears it in half. Perhaps the neighborhood was never his to rule, only his to look after.

nodes.title: Shared art | menus, logo, HUD + effects

widgets_values:
# Comfy Fighter Z
## Invent fictional fighters and a final boss. Build your arcade game.

The demo cards use Invent fictional reference: they create fresh designs from text and ignore the image selector. No photos or old sheets are loaded. To use your own new image, explicitly switch that card to Upload reference. Six fighter slots plus one Final boss slot close Arcade mode. Environment 1 supplies the title/select venue; disable slots 2 and 3 to build a one-stage game. Each fighter's arcade art adds two in-between sheets (45 poses) and an ending illustration. Set a NEW output folder, then load its assets.json + raw/ in /builder/.

**CLOUD ONLY / PAID:** default 90 image calls / 90 mapped assets (about $5.333). Source-reference generation is included when Invent is selected. The startup image and videos add 15 image calls and 16 silent LTX clips (86 seconds), about $11.813. Audio is the separate comfy-audio.json. Opening this graph spends nothing.

## Before you run

1. Install comfyui/custom_nodes/comfy_fighter_assets and restart ComfyUI.
2. Edit fictional descriptions, specials, supers, win quotes, endings and taglines; keep Invent mode for a demo without photo inputs.
3. Validate and review paid-call costs.
4. Review all 45 poses per fighter (27 required + 18 arcade in-betweens) before exporting a release.

Use comfyui/workflows/factory/ for one character, one sheet, one art image or one environment. The full native graph is under comfyui/workflows/advanced/.
